---
title: "Histograms"
---
```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
data("penguins")
```
A histogram can be used to plot one numeric variable

```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_len)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

You can add color to represent one categorical variable

```{r}
#| warning: false
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_len, fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram()
```

Customize the histogram by adding the 'bins' argument

```{r}
#| warning: false
ggplot(data = penguins, aes(x = flipper_len, fill = species)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20)
```
